example.thai: อยากตัดผมครับ
example.english: I'd like to get a haircut.

words.note: Thai hair salons often include a hair wash and scalp massage automatically as part of the haircut service.

example.thai: เอาทรงนี้ครับ

words.note: Showing a picture on your phone while saying 'ao sohng nii' is the most reliable way to explain your desired cut.

example.thai: ช่วยเล็มข้างๆ หน่อยครับ
example.english: Please trim the sides a bit.

words.note: Use 'lem' when you only want a light touch-up or clean-up around the edges without losing length.

example.thai: ไม่เอาสั้นมากนะครับ
example.phonetic: mâi ao sân mâak na khrap
example.english: Please don't make it too short.

words.note: Use 'sân' for length (hair, pants, skirts). For height, use 'têa' (short/short-statured).

example.thai: ตัดออกนิดหน่อยครับ
example.english: Just cut off a little bit.

words.note: Attaching 'nit-nòi' to your instruction helps prevent the barber from taking off too much length.
